_meta.description: The lines this site covers, in hub order. Each line's facts live in src/data/lines/<id>/. project.json and stations.json are required; every other file is optional, and a section without its file does not show. 'alignment' names the GeoJSON file the map and schematic draw from. 'about' feeds the line's schema.org node on every page of that line. 'position_basis' names where station coordinates come from: 'by_source' matches part of a station's location source_url, else 'default'. 'copy' holds the line's own wording for shared pages; {total}, {km} and {name} are filled in. Tokens in copy: {stations}, {as_of}, {pct:<activity>}, {target}, {earlier}, {rest}, {alt}, {minutes} come from project.json. Keys ending in _html may contain inline markup. 'number' is the line's mark; 'colour' names its colour token in src/styles/tokens.css (with an on- token for text on it); a line page whose colour is not line-orange takes it as its accent (data-accent on <html>). 'other_lines' gives a colour to lines the site does not cover, for their mark only; a line in neither list gets a neutral outlined mark. Line 5 and Line 12 share orange, so every mention of a line shows its number with the colour (LineMark.astro). 'dpr_label' names the project report that stations.json dpr_name and dpr_chainage_m come from (default: the 2019 project report, Line 12's). 'dropped_heading' names the group of dropped stations (default: Line 5's wording). 'extension_note' is said of every station on an extension of the line (stations.json `section`, Line 4A).

about.name: Mumbai Metro Line 5
about.description: A metro line from Thane through Bhiwandi and Durgadi to Kalyan in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, built by MMRDA in three phases. Phase 1, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, is built and awaiting trial runs.

copy.changes_section: MMRDA's Line 5 page still shows the plan of 2017. The revised plan of 2026 takes the line past Durgadi in a loop to Kalyan, adds a spur to Ulhasnagar and puts Bhiwandi station underground. Here is what changed, figure by figure and station by station.

copy.stations_page_description: The stations of {name} in order, from Kapurbawdi in Thane through Bhiwandi and Durgadi to Kalyan, and the Line 5A spur to Ulhasnagar, with interchanges and a page for each station.

copy.target_html: Target: {target} for Phase 1, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, from MMRDA's press release of May 2026. No exact date. The rest of the line: {rest}, as reported.
copy.lead_caption: The Kasheli creek bridge, between Balkum Naka and Kasheli: 550 m long, in spans of 42.23 m, about 15 m above the water, as reported. Illustration, not to scale; not an official design.
copy.map_section: The line on a street map. Choose a station to see where it sits, what surrounds it and what the street looks like today. The route to the Ulhas river bridge comes from MMRDA's alignment file of March 2025; Phase 3 and the spur come from the tentative key plan of March 2026.

copy.target_html: Target: {target} for the first stretch, Gaimukh to Cadbury Junction, as reported. MMRDA has announced no date. Two earlier reported targets, December 2025 and April 2026, passed. Wadala: October 2027, as reported.
